about_the_game:
Pack your bags – it’s time for a break from the horror… or is it?

The Summer in Rotwood DLC introduces new swimsuit outfits for both main characters, adding a chilling summer twist to your survival. Trade combat gear for beachwear and bad decisions as the R.I.P. team heads to the infamous Lake Rotwood – a peaceful vacation spot with a blood-soaked past, perfect for a little relaxation before diving back into the nightmare. So grab your sunscreen – and remember, at Lake Rotwood, the only thing hotter than the sun is the sight of our main characters pixel-abs on your CRT.

content_descriptors.notes: Flesh Made Fear contains heavy depictions of blood, gore, horror, frightening scenes, violence, some nudity and is not suited for children and young people under the age of 18.
